blocks.text: Prince Harry’s wife Meghan said Friday, Oct. 23, she was “deeply distressed” by accusations her father had possessed images of child abuse in his former home in the Philippines, adding she had blocked contact between him and her children over previous “troubling and disturbing” allegations. The Sun and Daily Mail newspapers reported that images had allegedly been found among her estranged father Thomas Markle’s belongings in Cebu. He denies all the claims.
